common_submission_shape.use: Populate only in an authorized external read-only capture system, then submit immutable references and digests through the evidence-adoption contract.

external_record_shape: one complete declaration for each C01-C04 at Lv41/Lv55/Lv60
three distinct capture_run_id values for each profile
gate_scope with one canonical profile_id and deterministic_run_index 1, 2 or 3
shared engine/project/map/template/input family and byte-identical canonical log digest within each triplet
physical and magical observations
defense and penetration ordering observations
formula revision, boundary and hold-out vector references
hit/dodge, critical-order and control-resistance observations
actor/target lifecycle and target-rank basis
formula branch and counterexample references
real engine field readback for action frames, attack speed and move speed
observed tick/distance trace
engine-to-design conversion review reference
real map/whitebox collision, pathing, safe-landing, target-range and camera observations
recorded input, position and outcome references
map and camera revision binding
authority captures for one, two, three and four active members
gate_scope with exactly one party_member_count from 1 through 4
member/lifecycle, encounter and time-basis snapshots
left, stale-lifecycle and cleanup observations with accepted-damage immutability
read-only object inventory and source-template readback
stable-key, field-reference and resource-inventory digests
no object, resource or map write during capture
